standards_pool.title: Line Operated Three-Phase A.C. Motors (IE Code) — Specification
standards_pool.scope: This standard covers energy efficient three-phase squirrel cage induction motors with rated voltage up to 1000 V and rated output from 0.12 kW to 1000 kW for continuous industrial duty S1, defining efficiency classes IE1, IE2, IE3, and IE4. Excludes traction motors and hazardous explosive atmospheres.

clauses.content: Rated output shall be specified in kilowatts (kW) for continuous duty S1.
The efficiency levels for IE3 motors shall be measured according to IS 15999.
Terminal box protection shall be at least IP 55.

standards_pool.title: Three-Phase Induction Motors — General Purpose Specification
standards_pool.scope: Covers general purpose three-phase induction motors with rated output from 0.37 kW to 100 kW for general industrial applications.

clauses.content: Rated output shall be for continuous duty.

standards_pool.title: Single-Phase Small A.C. Motors for Domestic and Similar Applications
standards_pool.scope: Covers small single-phase A.C. electric motors intended exclusively for domestic appliances and consumer household products. Excludes continuous industrial duty.

clauses.content: Intended solely for intermittent household appliance use.

standards_pool.title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
standards_pool.scope: Covers high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes manufactured from PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 for municipal and industrial potable water conveyance. Excludes high temperature steam and chemical conveyance above 60 deg C.

clauses.content: Pipes extruded from PE 100 raw material.
Pressure rating PN 6, PN 10, or PN 16.

standards_pool.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
standards_pool.scope: Covers steel plates, sections, flats, and beams for structural fabrication in bridges and buildings.

clauses.content: Grade E250 quality A steel minimum yield strength 250 MPa.

standards_pool.title: Historical Obsolete Specification for Steam Locomotives
standards_pool.scope: Old retired specification for coal-fired steam boiler locomotives.
